title: A provider-down record read from _cache/ has no bound, so a corrupt or far-future until blocks a host until the file is deleted
goal: provider.host_down ignores, or clamps to DOWN_CAP_S, a record whose until lies more than DOWN_CAP_S after its at or after now, so no file under _cache/provider-down/ can keep a host unasked past the cap. Found by the SP-u5q37ds3 review (_tools/provider.py _down_rec, host_down).

run: import sys, json, time, tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import provider; provider.DOWN_DIR=tempfile.mkdtemp(); now=time.time(); json.dump({'at':now,'until':now+1e9,'count':1,'error':'URLError: x'}, open(provider._down_path('example.com'),'w')); sys.exit(1 if provider.host_down('https://example.com/a') else 0)
